ruleName: Relief from Abnormal Course Conditions (Including Immovable Obstructions)
title: Ball moving in temporary water: must the player lift it immediately?
question: Peter’s ball is moving in temporary water and he intends to take relief. Must Peter immediately lift the moving ball?

choices.text: No. He may allow it to move to a better position before taking relief, provided he does not unreasonably delay play.
Yes, unless another player agrees otherwise.

explanation: A player whose ball is moving in temporary water may allow it to come to rest in a better position before taking relief, provided that they do not unreasonably delay play. There is no requirement to lift the ball immediately.
imagePrompt: A polished, modern semi-realistic (about 75% realistic, 25% stylised) illustration in an established junior golf quiz style. Show a male golfer (Peter) on a fairway observing his golf ball slowly moving in a visible patch of temporary water, with ripples around the ball to show its movement. The player is waiting, not acting. Capture recent heavy rain with puddles or shallow standing water on the fairway. The scene must not include any text, labels, numbers, arrows, captions, diagrams, badges, logos, watermarks, club crests, scorecards or speech bubbles.
imageAlt: A golfer on a fairway watches his golf ball slowly move across a patch of temporary water after rain, illustrating the rules about taking relief when a ball is moving in water.

sceneSpec.setting: A well-kept golf fairway after heavy rain, with patches of shallow standing water (‘temporary water’) clearly visible.
sceneSpec.players: One adult male golfer (Peter) shown waiting and watching his golf ball.
sceneSpec.ballPosition: The ball is shown gently moving along the surface in a puddle of temporary water, not yet having come to rest.
sceneSpec.ruleMoment: Capture the moment where the player is observing the ball as it moves in the temporary water before choosing to take relief.
sceneSpec.educationalFocus: Illustrates that a player does not have to lift a moving ball immediately when it is moving in temporary water, as long as play is not unreasonably delayed.
